newsitem.title: UK: Anglian jumps after H1 pre-tax profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Anglian jumps after H1 pre-tax profit rise.

text.p: Shares in window manufacturer Anglian Group Plc rose on Tuesday after the group announced a 12 percent jump in first half pre-tax profits and gave an upbeat forecast for the remainder of the year.
By 1054 GMT the stock was up 12-1/2 pence, or six percent, at 222.

Anglian said its first half profit on continuing business rose to 9.5 million stg from 8.5 million in the same period a year ago. Its dividend was raised to 3.6 pence per share from a previous 3.0 pence.

"As a result of the renewed focus on the core business and the initiatives we have taken to capitalise on an improving retail market, the group enters the second half-year with a healthy order book which is expected to underpin further growth in sales," said Anglian chief executive Eddie Boss.
